description: This source file defines an extension for the CritterStatusLabel SwiftUI view, adding properties and methods related to its visual state and animations. It manages various animated behaviors such as blinking, wiggling, and responding to state changes, as well as rendering the icon image based on the Critter's current status.

methods.name: isWorkingNow
methods.description: Computed property to determine if the Critter is currently working, based on its icon state and isWorking flag.

methods.name: effectiveAnimationsEnabled
methods.description: Computed property to determine if animations should run, considering the animationsEnabled flag and isSleeping state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The main SwiftUI view body that displays the Critter's status icon and visual effects, with various state-driven behaviors and animations.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Periodic update method that manages blinking, wiggling, and movement animations based on timing and Critter state.

methods.name: iconImage
methods.description: Generates the current icon image representing Critter status, considering states like sleeping, paused, or active, and rendering badges if needed.

methods.name: resetMotion
methods.description: Resets all motion-related animation state variables to default zero values.

methods.name: blink
methods.description: Performs a blinking animation with timing controlled via async task.

methods.name: wiggle
methods.description: Performs a wiggle animation with a spring effect, randomly fluctuating angle and offset.

methods.name: wiggleLegs
methods.description: Animates leg movements to simulate leg wiggling, with timing controlled asynchronously.

methods.name: scurry
methods.description: Animations that simulate the Critter scurrying by moving legs and offset with easing.

methods.name: wiggleEars
methods.description: Animates the ears with a spring effect, randomly wiggling and then resetting.

methods.name: scheduleRandomTimers
methods.description: Initializes timers for blinking and wiggling behaviors, based on the current date.

methods.name: gatewayNeedsAttention
methods.description: Determines if the Critter's gateway status requires user attention, excluding sleeping state.

methods.name: gatewayBadgeColor
methods.description: Returns a color representing the Critter's gateway status (failed or stopped).
